title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
scope: Specifies requirements for luminaires for road, street, highway, expressway lighting, and other public outdoor area lighting, with supply voltages not exceeding 1000 V. Covers mechanical strength, IP ingress protection (IP65/IP66), photometric performance, thermal endurance, and electrical safety.
test_methods: IS 16107 (Part 1) : 2012: Methods of Measurement of Lumen Maintenance of Solid-State Light Sources
IS 12063 : 1987: Ingress Protection (IP 66 / IP 65) Water and Dust Ingress Test
IS 9000 (Part 5) : 1981: Basic Environmental Testing Procedures - Damp Heat Test
regulatory_order: Electrical Equipment (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements - D.C. or A.C. Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Covers particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear (LED drivers) for use on DC supplies up to 250V and AC supplies up to 1000V at 50Hz/60Hz with output frequencies which deviate from supply frequency.
test_methods: IS 15885 (Part 1) : 2011: High Voltage Dielectric & Insulation Resistance Test
regulatory_order: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services having a rated wattage up to 60W and rated voltage up to 250V.
test_methods: IS 16106 : 2012: Method of Electrical and Photometric Measurements of Solid-State Lighting
regulatory_order: Electronics & IT Goods Order (CRO Phase-II)

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
scope: General code of practice for design and construction of plain and reinforced concrete structures. Covers materials, concrete mix proportions, durability requirements, structural analysis, limit state design for flexure, compression, shear, torsion, and deflection criteria.
test_methods: IS 516 (Part 1/Sec 1) : 2021: Compressive Strength of Concrete Specimens
IS 1199 (Part 2) : 2018: Fresh Concrete Workability Testing (Slump and Flow)

title: Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete (Third Revision - SUPERSEDED)
scope: OUTDATED: Third revision of IS 456 which relied extensively on Working Stress Method (WSM). Has been superseded by IS 456:2000.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires (TMT rebar) of Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600, and Fe 650 for use as reinforcement in concrete. Covers chemical composition (Carbon, Sulphur, Phosphorus max limits), mechanical yield strength, elongation, total elongation at maximum force (AgT), bend and rebend tests.
test_methods: IS 1608 (Part 1) : 2018: Tensile Testing (0.2% Proof Stress & Ultimate Tensile Strength)
IS 1599 : 2019: Mandrel Bend and 180° Reverse Rebend Test
IS 228 : 2020: Chemical Analysis of Carbon, Sulphur and Phosphorus in Steel
regulatory_order: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (Third Revision - SUPERSEDED)
scope: OUTDATED: Third revision of IS 1786 which lacked ductile grades (Fe 500D/550D) and AgT requirements for seismic regions. Superseded by IS 1786:2008.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Covers naturally occurring and manufactured coarse aggregates, fine aggregates (including crushed sand/M-sand), and recycled concrete aggregate (RCA) for use in concrete production.
test_methods: IS 2386 (Part 1) : 1963: Particle Size Sieve Analysis & Flakiness/Elongation Index
IS 2386 (Part 4) : 1963: Aggregate Crushing Value & Los Angeles Abrasion Test

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope: Specifies chemical and physical requirements for 33 Grade, 43 Grade, and 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC). Covers fineness by Blaine air permeability, standard consistency, initial and final setting times, soundness (Le Chatelier & Autoclave), and compressive strength at 3, 7, and 28 days.
test_methods: IS 4031 (Part 6) : 1988: Compressive Strength of Hydraulic Cement (min 53 MPa at 28 days)
IS 4031 (Part 5) : 1988: Initial (min 30 min) and Final Setting Time (max 600 min)
regulatory_order: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003 / 2021

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines (Second Revision)
scope: Provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes as per requirements using Ordinary Portland Cement, PPC, PSC, fly ash, GGBS, silica fume, and chemical admixtures. Includes High Strength Concrete (M65-M100) and Self-Compacting Concrete (SCC).

title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces - Code of Practice (First Revision)
scope: Covers design and detailing of RCC buildings located in seismic zones III, IV, and V. Specifies confinement reinforcement in columns, special hoop spacing, beam-column joint shear reinforcement, and shear wall detailing.

title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings (Sixth Revision)
scope: Specifies earthquake hazard zoning map of India (Zones II to V), response spectrum curves, design lateral force calculations, dynamic response spectrum analysis, torsion, and drift limits for building structures.

title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice (Third Revision)
scope: Code of practice for general construction in steel using Limit State Design method (LSD). Covers tension members, compression columns, flexural beams, plate girders, trusses, bolted connections, welded joints, fatigue, and fire protection.

title: Code of Practice for General Construction in Steel (Second Revision - SUPERSEDED)
scope: OUTDATED: Working Stress Method (WSM) version for steel design. Superseded by Limit State Design code IS 800:2007.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification (Seventh Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for hot rolled plates, sections, flats, bars, and wide flats of structural steel Grade E250, E275, E300, E350, E410, E450 for use in welded, bolted, and riveted structures (Quality A, B0, BR, C).
test_methods: IS 1608 (Part 1) : 2018: Yield Strength (min 250 MPa for E250) and UTS (410 MPa)
IS 1757 (Part 1) : 2020: Charpy Impact Energy at 0°C / -20°C (min 27 Joules)
regulatory_order: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Galvanized Steel Sheets (Plain and Corrugated) - Specification (Eighth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for hot-dip zinc coated (galvanized) plain and corrugated steel sheets and coils for roofing, cladding, and general engineering applications.
test_methods: IS 6745 : 1972: Mass of Zinc Coating Test (GSM 120, 180, 275 g/m2)
IS 277 Cl. 13: Bend Test for Zinc Adhesion
regulatory_order: Steel and Steel Products QCO 2020

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes (PE 63, PE 80, PE 100) from 16 mm to 1000 mm nominal outer diameter for buried and above-ground water supply pipelines.
test_methods: IS 12235 (Part 8/Sec 1) : 2019: Hydrostatic Internal Pressure Creep Rupture Test at 20°C and 80°C
IS 2530 : 1963: Carbon Black Content (2.0 to 2.5%) and Dispersion Test
IS 12235 (Part 2) : 2019: Melt Flow Rate (MFR) Testing
regulatory_order: Pipes and Fittings (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes for potable water supply, plumbing, and irrigation systems up to 630 mm outer diameter.
test_methods: IS 12235 (Part 8) : 2019: Internal Hydrostatic Pressure Test
IS 12235 (Part 9) : 2019: Impact Strength Test at 0°C (Falling Dart)
regulatory_order: Pipes and Fittings QCO 2020

title: Centrifugally Cast (Spun) Ductile Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for centrifugally cast ductile iron (DI) pipes (Class K7, K9, K12 and Class C) for water transmission, pumping mains, sewerage, and urban pipelines.
test_methods: IS 8329 Cl. 10: Hydrostatic Pressure Test at Works (up to 50 bar)
IS 8329 Cl. 11: Tensile Strength (min 420 MPa) and Elongation (min 10%)
regulatory_order: Ductile Iron Pipes and Fittings (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1: Steel Tubes (Sixth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for welded and seamless plain end or screwed and socketed steel tubes (GI pipes and MS black pipes) from 6 mm to 150 mm nominal bore for water, non-hazardous gas, air, and steam applications (Light, Medium, Heavy classes).
test_methods: IS 1239 (Part 1) Annex C: Hydrostatic Leak Tightness Test at 5 MPa (50 bar)
IS 2329 : 2005: Flattening and Bend Test on Steel Tubes
IS 6745 : 1972: Mass of Zinc Coating Determination (min 360 g/m2 / 400 g/m2)
regulatory_order: Steel Pipes and Tubes (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Drinking Water - Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Prescribes requirements, test methods, and acceptable/permissible limits in the absence of alternate sources for physical, chemical, toxic, and bacteriological characteristics of potable drinking water for human consumption.
test_methods: IS 3025 (Part 16) : 1984: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) Gravimetric Test
IS 3025 (Part 11) : 1983: pH Determination (6.5 to 8.5)
IS 1622 : 1981: Coliform and E. coli Detection by Membrane Filtration / MPN

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements and methods of test for packaged drinking water (in 20L jars, bottles, pouches). Requires multi-barrier treatment including filtration, RO/distillation, and UV/Ozonation disinfection.
test_methods: IS 14543 Annex A to G: Microbiological and Chemical Purity Testing
regulatory_order: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations & Mandatory BIS Order

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for single and multi-core PVC insulated copper and aluminium electrical wires and flexible cables up to 1.1 kV for building electrification, control panels, and industrial wiring.
test_methods: IS 10810 (Part 5) : 1984: Conductor Resistance Test (Ohm/km at 20°C)
IS 10810 (Part 45) : 1984: High Voltage Spark Test / Dielectric Breakdown (3 kV AC)
IS 10810 (Part 61) : 1988: Flame Retardance Test (FRLS - Oxygen Index >= 29%)
regulatory_order: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2019

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 2: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and including 33 kV (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for 3.3 kV to 33 kV cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated, screened, PVC/PE sheathed, armored power cables with copper or aluminium conductors for underground power distribution.
test_methods: IS 7098 (Part 2) Cl. 16.2: Partial Discharge Test (<= 5 pC at 1.73 Uo)
IS 7098 (Part 2) Cl. 16.3: High Voltage AC Withstand Test for 4 Hours
regulatory_order: Electrical Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2019

title: a.c. Static Direct Connected Smart Meters Class 1 and 2 - Specification (First Edition)
scope: Specifies requirements for electronic a.c. static direct connected smart electricity meters of accuracy class 1 and 2 with two-way communication (Cellular, RF Mesh, PLC) and connect/disconnect switch for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI / RDSS).
test_methods: IS 16444 Cl. 12: DLMS/COSEM Conformance and Communication Interoperability Test
IS 16444 Cl. 13: Load Switch Endurance Test (5000 make/break operations at rated current)
IS 16444 Cl. 11: Anti-Tamper & Magnetic Field Immunity (up to 0.5 Tesla)
regulatory_order: Smart Meters (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Outdoor Type Oil-Immersed Distribution Transformers up to and including 2500 kVA, 33 kV - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements and maximum permissible total losses at 50% and 100% loading for 3-phase and 1-phase oil-immersed outdoor type step-down distribution transformers up to 2500 kVA, 33 kV for power distribution utilities and industrial setups (Standard Energy Efficiency Levels 1, 2, and 3).
test_methods: IS 2026 (Part 1) : 2011: Measurement of Winding Resistance, Voltage Ratio and Impedance
IS 2026 (Part 2) : 2010: Temperature Rise Test (Top Oil & Winding)
IS 2026 (Part 3) : 2009: Dielectric Routine and Impulse Voltage Tests
regulatory_order: Distribution Transformers (Quality Control) Order, 2014 / 2021

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Lays down requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) modules suitable for long-term outdoor operation. Corresponds to IEC 61215.
test_methods: IS 14286 Cl. 10.11: Thermal Cycling Test (200 cycles from -40°C to +85°C)
IS 14286 Cl. 10.13: Damp Heat Test (1000 hours at 85°C and 85% RH)
IS 14286 Cl. 10.16: Mechanical Load Test (2400 Pa / 5400 Pa Snow/Wind load)
regulatory_order: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2017

title: Safety of Power Converters for use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Part 2: Particular Requirements for Inverters
scope: Specifies safety and operational requirements for power converters/inverters (grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid string inverters) for use in photovoltaic power systems. Corresponds to IEC 62109-2.
test_methods: IS 16169 : 2014: Anti-Islanding Disconnection Test (< 2 seconds upon grid loss)
IS 16221 (Part 2) Cl. 5: Protection Against Electric Shock, Short-Circuit, and Overvoltage
regulatory_order: Solar Photovoltaics Compulsory Registration Order, 2017

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - Part 1: General Requirements (Second Revision)
scope: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including computer servers, laptops, desktop PCs, POS terminals, printers, scanners, networking switches, CCTV cameras, and power adapters up to 600V.
test_methods: IS 13252 (Part 1) Cl. 5.1: Electric Strength and Touch Current Testing
IS 13252 (Part 1) Cl. 4.5: Thermal Heating and Flammability of Enclosures (UL 94 V-0/V-1)
regulatory_order: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (CRO) 2012 / 2021

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Secondary Lithium Cells and Batteries for Use in Portable Applications
scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of secondary lithium cells and batteries (Li-ion, Li-polymer, LiFePO4) used in portable electronic appliances, laptop computers, drones, and energy storage devices under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse. Corresponds to IEC 62133-2.
test_methods: IS 16046 (Part 2) Cl. 7.3.1: Continuous Charging at Constant Voltage & Over-charging Test
IS 16046 (Part 2) Cl. 7.3.2: External Short-Circuit Test at 55°C
IS 16046 (Part 2) Cl. 7.3.6: Crush Test (Hydraulic Ram 13 kN) & Thermal Abuse Test (130°C for 30 min)
regulatory_order: Electronics and IT Goods CRO 2012 / 2018

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for portable fire extinguishers of water, foam, dry powder (ABC and BC), clean agent, and carbon dioxide (CO2) types up to 9 kg/9 litre capacity. Harmonized with ISO 7165.
test_methods: IS 15683 Cl. 7: Fire Rating Performance Test (Class A Wooden Crib and Class B Heptane Pan Fire)
IS 15683 Cl. 9: Hydraulic Burst Pressure Test (min 2.5x Service Pressure)
IS 15683 Cl. 11: Electrical Conductivity Test (100 kV safe distance for ABC powder)
regulatory_order: Fire Extinguishers (Quality Control) Order, 2020

title: Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Automatic Fire Detection and Alarm System - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers the planning, design, installation, commissioning and maintenance of automatic fire detection and alarm systems in commercial, industrial, institutional and residential buildings (Addressable and Conventional systems).

title: Design and Installation of Fixed Automatic Sprinkler Fire Extinguishing Systems - Code of Practice (First Revision)
scope: Specifies design and installation criteria for automatic fire sprinkler systems for life safety and property protection across high-rise, commercial, and industrial occupancies (Light Hazard, Ordinary Hazard, Extra Hazard).

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for filtering half masks (FFP1, FFP2, FFP3 equivalent to N95/N99) used as respiratory protective devices against particulates, dusts, aerosols, and biological contaminants.
test_methods: IS 9473 Cl. 7.12: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE) and Particle Filtration (NaCl and Paraffin Oil)
IS 9473 Cl. 7.16: Breathing Resistance (Inhalation at 30 & 95 l/min, Exhalation at 160 l/min)
IS 9473 Cl. 7.9: Total Inward Leakage (TIL) Test on Human Test Subjects
regulatory_order: Personal Protective Equipment (Quality Control) Order, 2021

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for industrial safety helmets intended for use in mining, civil construction, manufacturing, and heavy industrial workplaces to provide head protection against falling objects and electrical shock.
test_methods: IS 2925 Cl. 8.2: Shock Absorption Test (transmitted force <= 5.0 kN upon 5 kg striker drop)
IS 2925 Cl. 8.3: Penetration Resistance Test (3 kg conical striker)
IS 2925 Cl. 8.4: Electrical Insulation Proof Test (2000V AC leakage < 3 mA)
regulatory_order: Personal Protective Equipment - Safety Helmets (Quality Control) Order, 2021

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies basic and optional requirements for safety footwear equipped with steel/composite toecaps providing protection against impact (200 Joules) and compression (15 kN). Harmonized with ISO 20345.
test_methods: IS 15298 (Part 1) : 2016: Test Methods for Footwear (Toe Impact 200J & Compression 15kN)
regulatory_order: Footwear Made from Leather and Other Materials (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / 2023

title: Code of Practice for Earthing (Second Revision)
scope: Covers practice for earthing of electrical installations for generation, transmission, distribution and utilization of electrical energy in commercial, industrial and domestic buildings. Includes pipe electrodes, plate earthing, chemical earthing, earth fault loop impedance, and touch/step potential calculations.
test_methods: IS 3043 Cl. 36: Earth Electrode Resistance Measurement with 4-Point Earth Megger

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies fundamental principles, design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of electrical wiring installations in residential, commercial and public buildings operating at voltages up to 1000V AC.
test_methods: IS 732 Cl. 6: Insulation Resistance Test (>= 1 MOhm at 500V DC) & Polarity Test

title: Ergonomics - Design Principles for Visual Display Terminal (VDT) Workstations
scope: Specifies ergonomic design principles and anthropometric guidelines for computer workstations, visual display terminal (VDT) setups, adjustable desks, monitor viewing distances, keyboard placement, and seating arrangements to minimize physical fatigue, eye strain, and musculoskeletal disorders in office environments.
test_methods: IS 14886 Cl. 5: Viewing Angle and Reach Envelope Anthropometric Evaluation

title: Mobile Phone Handsets Part 3: Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets - Specific Requirements (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies mandatory requirements for mobile phone handsets (smartphones, feature phones) to support text reading and input in all 22 scheduled Indian languages (Devanagari, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi, Urdu, etc.) with standardized in-script virtual/physical keypads and Unicode font rendering.
test_methods: IS 16333 (Part 3) Annex A: Indian Script Font Rendering & Transliteration Conformance Test
IS 16333 (Part 3) Annex B: Virtual and Physical Keypad Layout Conformance Verification
regulatory_order: Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets Order, 2016 / 2022

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements (Third Revision)
scope: Covers safety requirements for electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains, supply apparatus, battery or remote power feeding, intended for reception, generation, recording or reproduction of audio, video and associated signals (Smart TVs, Interactive Flat Panels IFPD, Conference displays, Public address amplifiers, set-top boxes). Harmonized with IEC 60065.
test_methods: IS 616 Cl. 10: Insulation Resistance & Dielectric Strength Test (3000V AC)
IS 616 Cl. 13: Temperature Rise Under Normal & Fault Conditions
IS 616 Cl. 19: Mechanical Drop and Impact Resistance of Housing
regulatory_order: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (CRO) Order, 2012 / 2021

title: Specification for Unplasticized PVC (uPVC) Flooring (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for flexible and semi-rigid unplasticized PVC sheet and tile floorings for use in commercial offices, hospitals, computer server rooms, laboratories, and administrative buildings. Covers thickness, dimensional stability, resistance to wear and abrasion, indentation under load, curling, and chemical resistance.
test_methods: IS 3464 Cl. 4: Indentation and Residual Indentation Test under 500 N Load
IS 3464 Cl. 6: Abrasion Resistance Test (Taber Wear Index)
IS 3464 Cl. 8: Dimensional Stability upon Heat Aging at 80°C

title: Methods of Test for Wooden and Office Chairs (First Revision)
scope: Specifies test procedures and performance requirements for static load, seat and back durability fatigue, corner impact, stability, and drop tests for ergonomic work chairs, revolving executive chairs, and office seating used in government institutions and public offices.

IS 5967 Cl. 6: Seat and Back Fatigue Durability Test (100,000 cycles)
IS 5967 Cl. 8: Forward and Rearward Overturning Stability Test

title: Desks, Tables and Workstations for Office and Educational Institutions - Requirements and Test Methods
scope: Specifies dimensions, mechanical safety, strength, deflection, stability, and durability requirements for office desks, executive tables, conference tables, and modular workstation partition systems for government offices and institutional buildings.
test_methods: IS 17631 Cl. 6: Horizontal and Vertical Static Load Tests on Tabletop
IS 17631 Cl. 7: Top Surface Durability, Abrasion & Scratch Resistance Test

title: Medical Electrical Equipment - Part 1: General Requirements for Basic Safety and Essential Performance (Third Revision)
scope: Applies to the basic safety and essential performance of medical electrical equipment and medical electrical systems (patient monitors, ECG machines, ventilators, defibrillators, electrosurgical units, infusion pumps, ultrasound scanners) used in hospital operating theatres, ICUs, and clinical facilities. test_methods: IS 13450 (Part 1) Cl. 8.7: Earth Leakage (< 500 uA) & Patient Leakage Current (< 10 uA) Testing
IS 13450 (Part 1) Cl. 8.8: Dielectric Withstand Voltage (4000V AC isolation between mains and patient applied part)
IS 13450 (Part 1) Cl. 15.3: Mechanical Strength & Impact Resistance of Medical Enclosure
regulatory_order: Medical Devices (Quality Control) Order / CDSCO Medical Device Rules, 2017 & 2022

title: Specification for Fowler Beds for Hospital Wards
scope: Specifies requirements for mechanically and electrically operated Fowler beds (multi-position hospital beds with adjustable backrest and knee-rest sections, collapsible side rails, IV pole attachments, and castor locking mechanisms) used in general hospital wards, trauma centres, and ICU care.

IS 7933 Cl. 8: Mechanism Tilt Crank Endurance Test (10,000 adjustment cycles)

title: Disinfectant Fluids, Phenolic Type - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements and methods of sampling and test for phenolic disinfectant fluids (Black Fluids and White Fluids / Phenyl) Grade 1, Grade 2, and Grade 3 used in municipal sanitation, public hospitals, railway stations, and institutional hygiene.

IS 1061 Annex C: Test for Absence of Tar Acids and Toxic Residues

scope: Establishes field inspection protocols, nondestructive evaluation, and periodic maintenance standards for Silica Fume Concrete Admixtures.

scope: Specifies physical, mechanical, and durability requirements for Flush Door Shutters Solid Core used in structural, residential, and infrastructure engineering.

scope: Specifies standard laboratory testing protocols, sampling criteria, and acceptance thresholds for testing Burnt Clay Hollow Bricks.

scope: Specifies standard laboratory testing protocols, sampling criteria, and acceptance thresholds for testing Manufactured Sand M-Sand.

scope: Provides structural design rules, load calculations, factor of safety, and site installation practices for Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement in civil engineering projects.

scope: Establishes field inspection protocols, nondestructive evaluation, and periodic maintenance standards for Cast Iron Manhole Covers and Gratings.

scope: Provides structural design rules, load calculations, factor of safety, and site installation practices for Ordinary Portland Cement Grade 53 in civil engineering projects.

scope: Provides structural design rules, load calculations, factor of safety, and site installation practices for Retroreflective Signboards for Expressways in civil engineering projects.

title: Guidelines for Maintenance, Quality Control and Inspection of Galvanized Steel Roofing Sheets
